headline: The plan costs margin: base-case net margin is 34.6% in FY2027E against our 35.5% floor, a ฿558 million shortfall, so F1 is not met.

body.note: Without the plan: 35.2%, also under our floor (FY2025 one-off gains). Only the optimistic case, a target by definition, holds it.

notes: We assume CPN pays all 560 million baht of net-new marketing. That lifts administrative costs to 17.4 percent of revenue in 2027. The conservative case crosses our 18 percent trigger. The base case margin falls to 34.6 percent, against our 35.5 percent floor: 558 million short. Without the plan the margin would be 35.2 percent, also below our floor, so the plan costs about 0.7 points. Our floor is FY2025's margin, which includes 3.2 points of one-off Rama 2 gains. Only the optimistic case holds our floor, and it is a target by definition. So the base case does not meet objective F1.
